Maritime Pre-Load Cargo Information (MPCI) – UAE 
 
Dear Valued Customer, 
As agents may be aware, the Maritime Pre-Load Cargo Information 
(MPCI) regime will come into effect in the United Arab Emirates 
(UAE) from 1 October 2026. 
MPCI is the UAE’s advance cargo-information filing Programme, 
administered by the National Advance Information Center (NAIC) of the UAE 
Government. The regime requires advance submission of maritime cargo 
information for shipments that are: 
 Imported into the UAE; 
 Transshipped through the UAE; or 
 Remaining on board (FROB) in the UAE. 
 
MPCI Charge 
Effective 15 September 2026, the Line will levy an MPCI charge of USD 35 per 
shipment, per Bill of Lading (BL) for cargo to be discharged at a UAE port 
for delivery within the UAE. 
The applicable MPCI charge is to be collected by the POL agents from the 
shippers. 
Please take note of the above and ensure that the applicable charge is duly 
communicated to and collected from the relevant shippers.
